caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a light brown, unadorned top surface. The front panel of the chest is decorated with a symmetrical floral design, featuring light pink, cream, and green colored elements against a black background. The floral design includes multiple stems and leaves branching outward, with stylized flower shapes with pale hues. The side panel of the chest is solid black without decoration. The chest has simple legs; the front legs are rectangular, and the back legs are cut with a sawtooth pattern. The image is centered on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or markings.
title: Chest
